question: What happened to the great-souled sage's condition as described to the great goddess?
premises: The sage is described as great-souled.
His state or body became reduced to ashes.
inference: The great-souled sage's condition was reduced to ashes.
uncertainties: Whether bhasmībhūtaṃ refers literally to the body or metaphorically to ego/condition is not explicit.
plain_english: O great goddess, that of the great-souled sage was reduced to ashes.
